vatSettings.title: VAT
vatSettings.description: The company's VAT regime and the rates Finance uses on invoices, in the price list and on recurring invoices. Changes are stored in Tax.
vatSettings.unavailable: The VAT settings could not be loaded right now. Please try again shortly.

vatSettings.firstRateDescription: The rate applies from the chosen day.
vatSettings.rateInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
vatSettings.fromRequired: Choose the day it applies from.
vatSettings.reasonExample: E.g. a change of the VAT act
vatSettings.reasonRequired: Enter a reason; it is kept in the history.
vatSettings.regimeDescription: The regime applies from the chosen day. For a day in the past, enter a reason.
